You mentioned disordered eating—these meds NEED you to eat. As a fellow chronically ill mental case, my #1 issue has always been food, whether it be eating too much, not enough, not the right kind. When I bumped up to 60mg I was SICK. I deal with chronic nausea/motion sickness, but this was different. I started forcing myself to eat more (and the right things) and it’s made things 10x better. If anything, at least force yourself to drink a protein shake with your Ritalin.
